It was a typical English summer night, drizzle was coming down all evening, the cobblestones where wet and the fields where muddy. Richard was having a smoke outside the Stilton cheese factory. The rebels had organized there as it was about the only large building in the tiny village. It had been a turbulent few weeks with the rebellion and such, Richard was playing back the events in his mind....

"They are incoming!!! There here!!" a voice shouted from the distance. Ohh shit things just got real, he threw away his cigarette butt and headed into the factory.

Behind a desk the commander was sitting reading some documents. He was a big broad guy with an extensive "Elliot" style mustache. "they are incoming sir" Henry told him.

"It's about bloody time!!" The rebel commander said on a loud tone! He stood up exposing not just being broad but nearly 2 meters tall as well. "lets get some payback for my little brother, get the men outside!!" He grabs a raincoat from his seat and reaches for a cricket bat in the umbrella stand.

"this should be good" Henry whispered under his breath and followed the commander out of the factory.

The men start marching to the crossroad in the middle off Stilton. When they arrive they will barricade the street with burning cars in the direction the English are coming from.

The English army arrives at the barricades.

A big bad silhouette with a giant mustache yells to them from the top of an overturned Double-Decker bus.

"We've been expecting you, yah bunch of lousy Cunts!!"

Commander james had been talking with some of the men during the march, not really expecting much to happen since the rebels were reported to be all the way in Coventry. the walk had been tiring to say the least, the drizzle hadn't been making it much better.

Approaching through the countryside, he realized they were going to pass through the town of Stilton currently unknown on their stance in the war. Realizing there wasn't much chance that there would be rebels he neglected to tell the army to be ready for anything since anything seemed to be pretty slim.

As they entered the town, on the main street he realized, he saw lights on and he figured that they were just inhabitants of the town. then he got a call on his radio. "sir there is a small kind of crash ahead, it may block our way over" he nodded and radioed to the tank commander "we may need you ready to take down a small crash in front of us" "roger that" said the tank commander.

Then as they got to the 'crash' he saw movement and a huge guy call out "We've been expecting you, yah bunch of lousy Cunts!!". Then as there was a huge group of men charging he called out "REMEMBER DON'T KILL UNLESS ABSOLUTELY NECESSARY" and "god save the queen"

With a loud "WRAAAAAAHHHHHHH" the rebel mob start to charge the UK regular army troops. The wet cobblestones make for a slippery surface and the first wave of assailants start to stumble and fall over each-other. The second wave crashes into them and pushes them into the UK army right in the middle of the ranks.

At this moment training kicks in with the regular army troops, they close ranks and starts to advance. "one, two, step!! heya!! one two step!!!" one step at a time the army starts to make ground and pushes the chaotic mob back across the town square.

"What's this you pussies??? I thought you wanted a proper fight!!! Get up and into it!!" The mustached mountain yells to his chaotic group of rebels.

Seeing all this mess 2,000 rebels decide to disengage and disperse back to their homes.
